$schema: doe-game-data weapon classes — v1 research draft

classes.damageScaleApprox: ~up to 2x (long swords cited ≈ 2x on community wiki scale)
classes.name: Sword
niche: Blade-length variety changes reach/handling
Greatsword is the 2H back-slot variant
classes.notes: Versatile melee in a variety of blade lengths. 2H variant: Greatsword (back slot).

classes.name: Dagger
niche: High-velocity throw with fast return — best throwable for precision
Skull Dagger (crypt): glows blue near skeletons, applies slow kinetics when thrown, stealth-kill capable, breaks when used on a guard
classes.notes: Close-quarters; thrown at high velocity with a quick return.

classes.name: Hammer
niche: Anti-armor specialist among 1H weapons
Tomb Breaker Hammer (crypt): smashes sealed tombs, one-hit kill on ordinary skeletons (NOT guards), follows the player when left behind
classes.notes: Hard-hitting; more effective on armored hostiles. Thrown distance is limited.

classes.name: Axe
niche: Magnetic recall on throw — returns like the doortovr-reviewed 'Kratos-like' throw
Only 1H weapon that doubles as a mid-range projectile
classes.notes: Reliable melee; throwable for a genuine mid-range option with magnetic recall.

classes.name: Spear
niche: Two-handed spear can PIN zombies to a wall or the ground — they cannot attack in this state (only vs zombies, only 2H)

classes.name: Bow
niche: Infinite ammunition — only ranged weapon with zero upkeep
Gravelight Bow (crypt): crystal arrows ignite what they hit, glows when enemies are near, blast knockback, illuminates crystal lights, explodes on impact
classes.notes: Ranged; unlimited arrows; effective on all hostile types.

classes.name: Crossbow
niche: Only one-handed ranged weapon — free off-hand for shield/sword pairing
classes.notes: One-handed ranged; bolt loaded with off-hand pull-back. Lowest relative damage scale of the ranged options.

classes.name: Magic Staff
niche: Gem-ammo economy — power gated by Power Gem inventory, not arrows
Chrono Staff (named variant, community wiki)
Crypt Keeper's Staff (crypt): guided light orb (trigger again to detonate), beam ignites nearby lights, can charge wall torches at cost of its own light, stays lit in back holster

Necromancer Staff (crypt): 3s charm beam — charmed enemy healed to 3x HP, follows and fights for you, has stab points for extra damage, consumes a gem per cast (gem returns when no charmed enemies remain)
classes.notes: Multiple staff types each with unique abilities. Requires Power Gems; insert a new gem when depleted.

classes.name: Shield
niche: Only item that blocks everything incl. projectiles
Quick shove forward = knockback attack
classes.notes: Defensive; protects against all hostile attacks and projectiles. Some perks grant an extra back slot reserved for shields.

cryptWeapons.context: Found inside tomb extraction runs (naked runs — no loadout brought in). Five weapons: Crypt Keeper's Staff, Tomb Breaker Hammer, Gravelight Bow, Necromancer Staff, Skull Daggers.
cryptWeapons.note: Details per-weapon are under each class's niche entries above.

damageFormulaNotes.firstStrike: Unaware enemy takes 3x damage on the first hit (official update notes).
damageFormulaNotes.perHitScaling: Base damage is multiplied by a per-weapon-type scale factor; community wiki reports long swords ≈ 2x, crossbows ≈ 1x (relative scale, not absolute damage numbers).
damageFormulaNotes.perkProc: 4 perk columns per weapon: col 1 = 40% proc chance, cols 2-4 = 32% each. Tier distribution: 0 perks 18.87%, 1: 39.21%, 2: 30.29%, 3: 10.32%, 4: 1.31%; avg 1.36 perks/hit (verified in the damage model).

enemyHitboxNotes.bat: Dies from the weakest of attacks.
enemyHitboxNotes.cryptGuard: Skull Dagger breaks when used on a guard; Tomb Breaker Hammer is NOT one-hit kill on guards.
enemyHitboxNotes.enemyColorization: Duller shades = lower tier; Red = Elite; Bright Purple = Legendary. Elemental colors: bright orange-red = fire (explosion/AOE), bright blue = ice (freeze), bright green = poison (stun + DoT).
enemyHitboxNotes.skeleton: Can block your weapon — but CANNOT block attacks aimed at feet/legs.
enemyHitboxNotes.zombie: Takes NO damage on body hits; dies INSTANTLY on head hit. Limbs can be chopped; crawls when legs removed.

gaps: Exact per-tier damage numbers and the six-tier material→damage mapping for Auric/Spectral (damage-cost tables are not public) — extract from game files.
Exact drop-rate percentages per weapon/perk — public sources only give chest-tier structure (see loot-and-tiers.md).
Full perk pool names/bonuses per column (beyond guaranteed Undead Fortune and Spectral Attack) — extract from game files.
Mythic weapon individual effects and cooldowns.
Club/Mace-specific niche stats vs Hammer — community wiki groups blunt weapons loosely.

legendaryClasses.name: Auric
niche: Economy weapon — converts undead kills into coin
legendaryClasses.notes: Shakes coins loose from undead enemies. Own six-tier materials, name colors, damage-cost tables (per official update notes; numeric tables not public).

legendaryClasses.name: Spectral
niche: Delayed-damage echo — effectively a second hit window on the same target
legendaryClasses.notes: Echoes your damage through the enemy a moment after the hit. Own six-tier materials, name colors, damage-cost tables (numeric tables not public).

mythicWeapons.gap: Individual mythic effects and cooldowns are not documented in public sources — extract from game files.
mythicWeapons.rule: One of nine different mythic weapons; each has a unique effect with a cooldown.

scope: Dungeons of Eternity (Othergate, VR). Public sources only: official update notes, community wiki (forsaken-planet.com via search index), UploadVR/Steam coverage of the Tomb Extraction update (Sept 2026).
slots: back (2H, plus shield with some perks)
